Product Description

The Levoit Core 400S-P Smart Air Purifier, is the efficienct air purifier to clean a whole room properly. AirSight Plus technology scans the surrounding air for airborne particles as small as 0.3um, this air purifier focuses on real-time home conditions - this is more than just having an air purifier. Levoit engineers designed the air purifier's internal structure to provide powerful air purification while maintaining noise levels as low as 24dB.

Features:

  • Intelligently purifies the air in a 1733 sq ft room per hour
  • An Efficient Middle Filter helps create a cleaner, healthier home - Our air purifiers are scientifically proven to capture particles as small as 0.3 microns including pollen, dust and more.
  • 360° filtration system uses activated carbon to remove gases and odors and a Efficient Middle Filter to capture 99.97% pollutants as small as 0.3 microns.
  • Automatically senses and reacts to changes in air quality - then reports pollution in real time on LCD screen and on your free VeSync Link app.
  • In the sleep mode, the air purifier monitors and purifies using the quiet settings, with a dimmed display and can be totally turned off.
  • Program your machine to turn off after pre-set intervals between 1 -12 hours.
  • Safe and easy to clean with low maintenance, easy-to-replace filters. With built-in notifications when they require replacing.
  • Using compatible voice control services, control your air purifier with simple, spoken instructions. Works with Alexa and Googlevoice Assistant.
  • Choose from a variety of replacement filters to best meet your needs. The Toxin Absorber Filter specializes in smog, toxins, and VOCs, while the Smoke Remover filter addresses smoke from wildfires, smoke, and other particulates. The Pet Allergy Filter captures fur and absorbs unpleasant odors.
  • Warning – unauthorized replacement filters are not tested. Only authentic Levoit filters are recommended to ensure a sealed system and proper functioning of the machine. The official Levoit Core 400S replacement filter can be found by searching "B08SQQK6K7" in the search bar.

5 out of 5 stars
Love my EverestAir
I intentionally waited a few months to make this review, just in case something ended up happening, and I’m glad to say that this device has exceeded my expectations. The touchscreen surface is very user friendly, and the app is just as easy to set up as it is to use. As Levoit’s largest unit, it is fairly heavy and big, and the wheels on the bottom only allow it to move from left to right, so be prepared to lift it when it comes time to clean the unit. The unit functions fantastic, it’s great at pulling pollutants out of the air, the allergies of both me and my dog have improved significantly since installing this. The air quality sensor is also top of the line compared to my other Levoit units. It gives exact measurements of the PM1.0, PM2.5, and PM10 in real time, while the Levoit Vital 100s & 200s (while still great air purifiers) will only rate your air quality out of four categories. The filter lasts a long time, and the performance in air purification and odor removal is consistent across its lifespan as long as the pre-filter is cleaned regularly. Other than that it’s pretty low maintenance. As someone who’s purchased both generic and brand, I do think the genuine Levoit filters are worth the extra cost. If you manage to find a generic filter that fits, I can almost guarantee the odor removal will be subpar when compared to the OEM filter. They go on sale every now and again, I recommend picking up a few during the sales, which can easily last you a couple of years. (Picture attached is a filter used for 10 months next to a new filter straight from the box) The quality of life improvement since installing air purifiers in my home has made the cost well worth it, and every purifier is from Levoit. Great brand, and they made a great product with this one. If you have a large space to purify, or want to splurge on a fancy air purifier for your bedroom, this is the one.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Works Beautifully
    Reviewed in the United States on June 17, 2023
    Set name: Core 600s-P White
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    We purchased one of these on sale in the hope it would help moderate the severity of pollen season in upstate NY and the dander generated by two large labradors. It has a nice, clean look and small foot print, which we feel is important.

    The HEPA filter was shipped inside it in a bag that needs to be removed but doing so was incredibly quick and easy to do. Twist the top a quarter turn and place to one side. Lift out the filter, remove the bag, lower the filter back in using the two tabs provided on it for that purpose, lift the lid back on and quarter twist to close. It takes 2 mins. Then its' plug-in, turn on and choose ""Auto" or a fan speed using the touch sensitive panel on top. You can control it from your iphone if you're into that but it certainly isn't necessary.

    The first thing we noticed is how quiet it is. Effectively soundless in sleep mode and at fan speed 1. Barely noticeable at fan speed 2, unless you're right next to it, noticeable at fan speed 3 when you are in the same room as it but not obnoxious. Noticeably louder at fan speed 4 which should be considered a 'Turbo" mode. Then we noticed the impact of running it - vastly reduced swelling of the eyes and sinuses of those suffering from hay fever and a significant reduction in the doggy smell of our labradors. It works really well.

    We have taken advantage of the ability to control this by iPhone to set a schedule where it automatically runs in sleep mode (low, continuous fan) from 10pm to 5am. Then at fan speed 2 from 5am to 5:30am, ramping up to fan speed 3 from 5:30am to 8am before switching to auto from 8am to 10pm. Because of the relatively severe allergies suffered by a couple of our family members the P2.5 micron threshold is set to 2 ug per meter cubed and this filter has been able to attain that incredibly low level with that schedule within a few hours of all windows and doors to the outside being closed to the 1800 sq. ft area it services. At this point we have an oasis for our hay fever sufferers to return to each evening and it's made an incredible difference to their comfort. Do they still take Claritin or Allegra during pollen season? Yes, we've found it necessary to deal with the pollen at work and in the garden. Are they doing better than they were before we got this filter? Yes, the continuously swollen and itchy, weeping eyes are gone. The inflamed nasal passages are gone. Their sleep deprivation is gone. Their quality of life has improved dramatically. We had no idea how dramatic an impact adding a quality, appropriately sized HEPA filtration system would have. This unit is rated for something like 3000 sq. ft. We're using to control air quality in a 1800 sq.f.t open plan area and its doing a great job of that without having to run the fan at high speed for prolonged periods of time.

    We've had this for several weeks now and experienced 1st hand how well it can deal with really terrible air quality when the smoke from the fires in Quebec blew into NY. Opening the door to come into the house with the shopping during the worst of it briefly dropped the air quality from a PM2.5 of 001 to as high as a PM2.5 of 185 within 12 feet of the door. This was then quickly reduced to a PM2.5 of less than 20 in an hour and back to 001 in about 2 hours after the door was closed. The outside airs PM2.5 was apparently North of 300 at this time (sources accuweather and the news), the air was literally a hazy brown like smog and this filter was able to detect it, automatically adjust its fan speed to clear it and maintain perfect air quality in the house.

    Does it work? Absolutely, quietly and brilliantly.

    Would we buy this again? Yes, in fact we have so that we can control the air quality for one of our allergy sufferers in another area where they have to spend prolonged periods of time. That one's been in place for about 3 weeks and has done exactly what we hoped it would do - improve the quality of life at work in a 7000 sq.ft. open plan office area. Now this is well beyond the manufacturers claimed coverage for a unit and it looks like they're right based on who's apparently benefiting and who isn't but here's the important point. The benefits to the workforce have been so noticeable to management they're now considering upgrading the offices HVAC system to include HEPA filtration. I think that speaks volumes.

    A Must-Have for Pet Owners!

    I am beyond impressed with the LEVOIT Core 400S-P Air Purifier! We have two Golden Retrievers, so dog hair and dander are a constant battle in our home. After just a short time using this purifier, I noticed a huge difference in the air quality and overall cleanliness of the house.

    The filter does an amazing job capturing pet hair, dust, and allergens. In fact, when I checked the filter, I was shocked by how much dog hair it had collected (see photo!). It’s clear this thing is working overtime. My home smells fresher, there’s less dust settling on surfaces, and even my seasonal allergies seem less noticeable.

    I also love the smart features—the air quality monitor, Auto Mode, and WiFi connectivity make it incredibly easy to use. It automatically adjusts when needed, so I don’t have to think about it. Plus, Sleep Mode is whisper quiet at night.

    If you have pets, especially larger shedding breeds like Golden Retrievers, this purifier is worth every penny. It’s one of the best home purchases I’ve made and has made a noticeable difference in our everyday comfort. Highly recommend! 🐾🐾

    Absolute game changer. We live in Oklahoma and around this time of year, the allergens and pollen are in full effect. Every year, we suffer and get sick constantly cause its so bad. On top of that, we have 2 indoor cats and an outdoor cat that periodically comes in, so we got to deal with pet dander x3. I was debating on getting an AirDoctor but was wanting something a little more affordable and was just as good. After hours of research, I decided on the Levoit Core 600S-P. Installation was rather easy and quick. I like that it is also a smart purifier as in it has its own app that you can manage wirelessly over a wifi or cellular connection (Purifier needs to be connected to your network). Once I turned it on, I noticed that it quickly scans the area for air quality. My air quality was so bad, I was honestly disappointed that I didnt invest in a air purifier sooner. The registered PM2.5 index was over 600!!! That's considered HAZARDOUS conditions. I cant believe we were suffering for this long. Well, after about a couple hours at the 2nd to highest setting, I noticed the Air quality was immensely better. Breathing was way easier and after just 24 hours, allergy symptoms were beginning to subside. My wife was suffering from the worst sinus congestion and pressure due to the allergies and that has now completely gone away after 2 days.

    What I also like about this Levoit is the air flow. Just at a lower settings I can literally feel air circulation at 20 ft away from my living room. The max fan setting pulls in air fast, which is nice if needing to filter your air quickly. The highest setting is loud, but that doesnt really bother me. Let that thing work haha. The lowest setting is super quiet, so its great for sleeping as well.

    Its been several days of me having this product and it truly is one of the best investments I have made. If you suffer from allergies and have multiple pets, the Levoit wont let you down. Our overall quality of life in our home has greatly improved now that we are breathing cleaner air. Definite recommend.

    I intentionally waited a few months to make this review, just in case something ended up happening, and I’m glad to say that this device has exceeded my expectations.

    The touchscreen surface is very user friendly, and the app is just as easy to set up as it is to use. As Levoit’s largest unit, it is fairly heavy and big, and the wheels on the bottom only allow it to move from left to right, so be prepared to lift it when it comes time to clean the unit.

    The unit functions fantastic, it’s great at pulling pollutants out of the air, the allergies of both me and my dog have improved significantly since installing this. The air quality sensor is also top of the line compared to my other Levoit units. It gives exact measurements of the PM1.0, PM2.5, and PM10 in real time, while the Levoit Vital 100s & 200s (while still great air purifiers) will only rate your air quality out of four categories.

    The filter lasts a long time, and the performance in air purification and odor removal is consistent across its lifespan as long as the pre-filter is cleaned regularly. Other than that it’s pretty low maintenance. As someone who’s purchased both generic and brand, I do think the genuine Levoit filters are worth the extra cost. If you manage to find a generic filter that fits, I can almost guarantee the odor removal will be subpar when compared to the OEM filter. They go on sale every now and again, I recommend picking up a few during the sales, which can easily last you a couple of years. (Picture attached is a filter used for 10 months next to a new filter straight from the box)

    The quality of life improvement since installing air purifiers in my home has made the cost well worth it, and every purifier is from Levoit. Great brand, and they made a great product with this one. If you have a large space to purify, or want to splurge on a fancy air purifier for your bedroom, this is the one.

    Ich habe mir den Luftreiniger gekauft, weil ich zu Hause E-Zigarette rauche und nicht ständig lüften möchte - vor allem abends oder im Winter. Nach ein paar Tagen Nutzung kann ich sagen: Genau dafür erfüllt er seinen Zweck sehr gut.

    Der LEVOIT läuft bei mir fast täglich im Wohnzimmer. Schon nach kurzer Zeit merkt man, dass der Dampf deutlich schneller verschwindet und die Luft frischer wirkt. Gerade auf mittlerer Stufe ist er effektiv, ohne unangenehm laut zu sein. Besuch hat mich sogar schon gefragt, ob ich überhaupt drinnen rauche - das sagt eigentlich alles. Auch Gerüche setzen sich weniger fest als vorher.

    Ganz ehrlich: Wunder darf man nicht erwarten. Direkt beim Dampfen riecht man es natürlich trotzdem kurz, und wie langlebig Gerät und Filter sind, wird sich erst mit der Zeit zeigen. Der Filterwechsel ist auch kein Schnäppchen, was man einkalkulieren sollte. Bisher macht das Gerät aber einen soliden Eindruck.

    Empfehlen würde ich ihn vor allem Rauchern, Dampfern und Allergikern, die ihre Raumluft spürbar verbessern wollen, ohne ständig Fenster aufzureißen. Für sehr große, offene Räume oder wenn man absolute Stille erwartet, ist er eher weniger geeignet. Ich bin insgesamt zufrieden - jetzt bleibt nur abzuwarten, wie er sich langfristig schlägt.

Product Description

The Levoit Core 400S-P Smart Air Purifier, is the efficienct air purifier to clean a whole room properly. AirSight Plus technology scans the surrounding air for airborne particles as small as 0.3um, this air purifier focuses on real-time home conditions - this is more than just having an air purifier. Levoit engineers designed the air purifier's internal structure to provide powerful air purification while maintaining noise levels as low as 24dB.

Features:

  • Intelligently purifies the air in a 1733 sq ft room per hour
  • An Efficient Middle Filter helps create a cleaner, healthier home - Our air purifiers are scientifically proven to capture particles as small as 0.3 microns including pollen, dust and more.
  • 360° filtration system uses activated carbon to remove gases and odors and a Efficient Middle Filter to capture 99.97% pollutants as small as 0.3 microns.
  • Automatically senses and reacts to changes in air quality - then reports pollution in real time on LCD screen and on your free VeSync Link app.
  • In the sleep mode, the air purifier monitors and purifies using the quiet settings, with a dimmed display and can be totally turned off.
  • Program your machine to turn off after pre-set intervals between 1 -12 hours.
  • Safe and easy to clean with low maintenance, easy-to-replace filters. With built-in notifications when they require replacing.
  • Using compatible voice control services, control your air purifier with simple, spoken instructions. Works with Alexa and Googlevoice Assistant.
  • Choose from a variety of replacement filters to best meet your needs. The Toxin Absorber Filter specializes in smog, toxins, and VOCs, while the Smoke Remover filter addresses smoke from wildfires, smoke, and other particulates. The Pet Allergy Filter captures fur and absorbs unpleasant odors.
  • Warning – unauthorized replacement filters are not tested. Only authentic Levoit filters are recommended to ensure a sealed system and proper functioning of the machine. The official Levoit Core 400S replacement filter can be found by searching "B08SQQK6K7" in the search bar.
